description: This file contains unit tests for the Mattermost server's database configuration management, including setup, retrieval, comparison, and file operations within a database-backed configuration store.

methods.name: getDsn
methods.description: Returns the data source name (DSN) string, which is simply the source string passed to it.

methods.name: setupConfigDatabase
methods.description: Sets up the database with a given configuration and optional files, inserting configuration data and files into the database for testing.

methods.name: getActualDatabaseConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the current active configuration from the database, unmarshalling JSON data into a Config object.

methods.name: assertDatabaseEqualsConfig
methods.description: Asserts that the current database configuration matches the expected configuration.

methods.name: assertDatabaseNotEqualsConfig
methods.description: Asserts that the current database configuration does not match the given configuration.

methods.name: newTestDatabaseStore
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the database-backed configuration store, optionally with custom defaults.

methods.name: TestDatabaseStoreNew
methods.description: Unit tests for creating new database store instances under various conditions.

methods.name: TestDatabaseStoreGet
methods.description: Tests that the store's Get method returns the current configuration consistently.

methods.name: TestDatabaseStoreGetEnvironmentOverrides
methods.description: Tests that environment variable overrides are correctly reflected in the configuration.

methods.name: TestDatabaseStoreSet
methods.description: Tests setting new configurations, including validation, persistence, and notification.

methods.name: TestDatabaseStoreLoad
methods.description: Tests loading configurations from the database, including environment overrides and error handling.

methods.name: TestDatabaseGetFile
methods.description: Tests retrieving configuration files stored in the database.

methods.name: TestDatabaseSetFile
methods.description: Tests setting and overwriting configuration files in the database.

methods.name: TestDatabaseHasFile
methods.description: Tests checking for the existence of files in the database.

methods.name: TestDatabaseRemoveFile
methods.description: Tests removing files from the database.

methods.name: TestDatabaseStoreString
methods.description: Tests the string representation of the database store, ensuring masking of sensitive info.

methods.name: TestCleanUp
methods.description: Tests the cleanup process that prunes old configurations, ensuring active configs are preserved.
